method: Inspected the three actual Penpot row PNG exports and the full comparison export.
findings: Exactly three initial-state concepts are present and all three use a shared palette rather than per-tag colours.
The tide dial's eight names and glyphs follow the outside of the crescent; the needle is clear of the text and the precision notches remain visible.
The spool viewport exposes Predator, Schooling and Small, clipping the other five logical tag regions. Both fixed index tips are clear of the ribbon text.
The chart shows all eight bearings, with alternating labels clear of the route and the independent boat marker. Fine contour engraving does not obscure the labels.
Headers, instructions, captions and Stop controls fit their bounds. The full board shows all three concepts without overlap or clipping.
The review explicitly identifies alternate motion paths as visual proposals, with no runtime implementation.
scope: Static Penpot visual review only; not gameplay, motion timing or probability validation.
